clue.text: Meal's ready when larva has surfaced!

parts.note: a grub is the larva of a beetle or other insect
something that has surfaced has come up

explanation.surface: An exclamation at the moment a creature emerges from the soil, oddly taken as a dinner call.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grub's up!' is the informal British call that food is on the table.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a colloquial announcement that food is served, grub being slang for food.

clue.text: Was surprised, openly

parts.note: someone visibly astonished stares with mouth wide open, the 'openly' hinting at that open mouth

explanation.definitionFit: To stare open-mouthed in amazement is the visible sign of being taken aback.

clue.text: Dandy expression you are said to be leaving is noble act

parts.note: a beau is a fashionable dandy

indicators.note: the letters standing for 'you are' depart from the word for expression

parts.note: a gesture is an expression of feeling

indicators.note: 'you are' spoken aloud sounds like the two letters U and R, text-speak style

parts.note: taken as the phrase spoken aloud

explanation.surface: A fop's remark is praised as a gallant deed after someone departs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be leaving' takes UR (how 'you are' sounds) out of GESTURE, leaving GESTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A beau geste is a gracious or magnanimous gesture, a fine deed done for show of honour.

clue.text: Deserter in Malay boat found it was in proportion

indicators.note: the deserter sits inside the boat's name

parts.note: a proa is a Malay sailing boat
a rat is one who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship

explanation.surface: Someone discovers a runaway aboard a Malay vessel, and somehow it was all proportionate.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means proportionally, each sharing according to their stake.

clue.text: Rodenticide used in RAF manoeuvres after hostilities

indicators.note: the shuffled letters are placed following the word for hostilities

parts.note: war is open hostilities

indicators.note: the letters of 'in RAF' are moved about like aircraft in manoeuvres

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A rat poison deployed during air force exercises once fighting is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' is only a link; 'manoeuvres' acts on the two words just before it, and the hostilities piece leads the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: This anticoagulant was first developed as a rat poison before medical use.

clue.text: Jack supporting rambling plant

indicators.note: in a down answer the sailor sits beneath and holds up the rambling word

parts.note: to ramble is to wander
a jack, or jack tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A man named Jack holds up a sprawling climbing plant.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'supporting' places SAILOR below WANDERING.
explanation.definitionFit: Tradescantia, a trailing houseplant, goes by this common name.

clue.text: Weed with scrap above and below

indicators.note: in a down answer the first scrap sits on top of the W
in a down answer the second scrap sits beneath the W

parts.note: a rag is a scrap of cloth
an ort is a scrap of leftover food

explanation.surface: A gardener describes a weed tangled with rubbish above it and beneath it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scrap' gives two different words: RAG above W and ORT below it. ORT, a crossword favourite, is a morsel left from a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A yellow-flowered plant of fields, regarded as a weed and toxic to livestock.

clue.text: Be delighted about said lady

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: the lady's name is heard spoken, giving the spelling it sounds like

parts.note: Joyce is a woman's name

explanation.surface: Someone is told to be pleased about a woman being mentioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' turns the name JOYCE into the same-sounding JOICE.
explanation.definitionFit: To rejoice is to feel or show great joy.

clue.text: Attractive but extremely cold spot

parts.note: 'attractive' is meant magnetically: compass needles are drawn toward a freezing place at the top of the globe

explanation.definitionFit: The Arctic pole is bitterly cold and lies near where compasses point, so it attracts.

clue.text: Vegetable squashed in middle of footpath

indicators.note: the letters are crushed and rearranged
the word footpath loses its first and last letters, keeping its inside

explanation.surface: A vegetable lies flattened in the centre of a path.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' footpath gives OOTPAT, which 'squashed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuber eaten as a staple vegetable.

clue.text: Bird having late evening drink

parts.note: night follows late evening
a jar is British slang for a drink, usually of beer

explanation.surface: Someone having a nightcap at the end of the evening.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'jar' is everyday British slang for a pint at the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A nocturnal bird with a churring call, also called a goatsucker.

clue.text: Shame it's a prayer from the underworld!

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and the name of that realm
grace is a short prayer said before a meal

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a prayer has come up from hell.
explanation.definitionFit: Disgrace and shame are synonyms for a loss of honour.

clue.text: Less than one above average aloft

indicators.note: the word one falls short by a letter, its last being cut

parts.note: high means above average

explanation.surface: A figure below one and above average floats up high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Less than' trims the last letter from ONE, leaving ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean up in the sky or at a height.

clue.text: Fiat cars transporting wine

indicators.note: the letters are carried off and moved about into new places

explanation.surface: Italian cars carrying a cargo of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Frascati is a white wine from the hills near Rome.

clue.text: Everybody would, say, first anticipate

indicators.note: the forest comes before the word for everybody

parts.note: 'would' sounds like wood, and a wood is a forest
all means everybody

explanation.surface: Everybody would claim to get in first, which is to anticipate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' signals the sound of 'would': wood, a synonym for FOREST.
explanation.definitionFit: To forestall is to act in advance to prevent, so to anticipate.

clue.text: Went first as well round Spanish city

indicators.note: the word for 'as well' wraps around the other piece

parts.note: too means as well
led means went first

explanation.surface: Someone who led the way also circled a Spanish city.
explanation.definitionFit: Toledo is a historic city in central Spain famous for steel.

clue.text: Bighead's generosity

definitions.meaning: read as 'big head', a ... or headland on the coast

explanation.definitionFit: Cryptically a big headland, LARGE plus NESS (a headland); literally liberal bigness of spirit, like largesse.

clue.text: Begrudge being made to go again

definitions.meaning: to begrudge is to feel bitter about

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is feeling aggrieved; the other, split re-sent, is posted a second time.

clue.text: Sign stinger has been detailed

indicators.note: de-tailed: the stinger loses its tail, its last letter

parts.note: a scorpion is an arachnid with a sting in its tail

explanation.surface: A warning sign explains a stinging creature in detail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' means de-tailed here: SCORPION drops its final N.
explanation.definitionFit: Scorpio is a sign of the zodiac, the Scorpion.

clue.text: A live TV broadcast from the city

indicators.note: the letters are scattered like a transmission and reassembled

explanation.surface: A live television programme transmitted from a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Tel Aviv is a major Israeli city on the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Get round Rex with uncultured lady

indicators.note: the word Get goes around the king's letter

parts.note: taken as written
R is the abbreviation for Rex, Latin for king
rude can mean unrefined or uncultured

explanation.surface: An instruction to encircle a king accompanied by a vulgar woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Gertrude is a woman's name, such as Hamlet's mother.

clue.text: Wild and disorderly south American city's holding out badly

indicators.note: the city's name with its 's encloses the other letters

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a South American city, plus the 's

indicators.note: the letters of 'out' are done badly, jumbled

explanation.surface: A rowdy South American city is said to be badly holding out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges OUT into TOU, which RIO'S holds.
explanation.definitionFit: Riotous describes unruly, boisterous behaviour.

clue.text: Spade taken from second shack

parts.note: a hovel is a shack

explanation.surface: A spade is taken out of a second shed.
explanation.definitionFit: A shovel and a spade are both digging tools.

clue.text: Over everything of the highest importance

parts.note: above means over
all means everything

explanation.surface: Something placed over everything as the top priority.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means most importantly, before anything else.

clue.text: Ruler of the waves?

parts.note: not a monarch at sea but a big passenger ship that dominates the ocean, or a ruler that draws lines

explanation.definitionFit: An ocean-going passenger ship sails over the sea as if in command of it.

clue.text: Ratification of additional premium for Valerie

parts.note: AP is the insurance abbreviation for additional premium
pro means for, in favour of
Val is the short form of Valerie

explanation.surface: An insurer's extra charge for a woman named Valerie is signed off.
explanation.definitionFit: Approval and ratification both mean formal consent.

clue.text: Single male in front of band

parts.note: one means single
man means male

explanation.surface: A bachelor stands at the front of a band.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a fill-in: a performer playing every instrument alone is a one-man band.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-man band is a solo street performer playing several instruments.

clue.text: Examine cursorily view across

parts.note: a look is a view
over means across

explanation.surface: Someone glances briefly at the view across the way.
explanation.definitionFit: To glance at something quickly, without close inspection.

clue.text: She is not the only child in the ward

definitions.text: She is not the only child in the ward

parts.words: She is not the only child in the ward
parts.note: a female sibling means her parents had more than one child, and the senior nurse running a hospital ward bears the same title

explanation.definitionFit: A female sibling, and also the senior nurse in charge of a hospital ward.
